title: Skills review: fewer, truer rules across every skill, conflicts named and cut

chat.text: An Opus system architect measures every skill by script (words, hard rules, dead links, how often it was loaded), has Haiku find the rules that disagree, repeat, or describe retired systems, applies the safe half (merge, delete, fix links, fold improvements) and writes the rest as proposals, with CLAUDE.md changes in their own ask-first section. Before and after word counts on the card.

message.text: Landed. The skills dropped from 34,140 to 27,522 words (−19%), rule lines from 225 to 189, open improvement notes from 45 to 27, and dead links from 9 to 7 (the 7 left are template examples). I found and fixed 5 conflicts; the rest are proposals, CLAUDE.md ones first: /framework/ai/doc/skills-proposals-2026-10-13.md

The new `make` skill is committed as 08af2e3d0. It replaces `naming` and `new-page` with four steps: name it, place it, class it, show it. It includes your rule that a file about a module lives in that module's folder, and a strictly AI class lives under framework/ai. A 17:38 merge had stashed these files before they were committed; I restored them unchanged from the stash commit, and the tree is clean of my files (5007072a2). Details are in the proposals doc: /framework/ai/doc/skills-proposals-2026-10-13.md
